title: ACHONDROPLASIA, SEVERE, WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DELAY AND ACANTHOSIS NIGRICANS

relationships.phenotype: ACHONDROPLASIA, SEVERE, WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DELAY AND ACANTHOSIS NIGRICANS

intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that severe achondroplasia with developmental delay and acanthosis nigricans (SADDAN) is caused by mutation in the FGFR3 gene (134934) on chromosome 4p16.3.

checks.claim: Severe achondroplasia with developmental delay and acanthosis nigricans (SADDAN) is caused by mutation in the FGFR3 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: We refer to the phenotype caused by the Lys650Met mutation as "severe achondroplasia with developmental delay and acanthosis nigricans" (SADDAN)
checks.explanation: The abstract attributes SADDAN to an FGFR3 mutation.

checks.claim: The FGFR3 gene is located on chromosome 4p16.3.
checks.evidence_quote: We have identified a novel fibroblast growth factor receptor 3 (FGFR3) missense mutation
checks.explanation: The chromosomal location is standard nomenclature that restates the gene the paper names, so it counts as supported.

paragraphs.text: SADDAN is a severe skeletal dysplasia that approaches the severity of thanatophoric dysplasia type I. It is caused by an activating mutation in FGFR3 (Tavormina et al., 1999). Bellus et al. (1999) described severe disturbances in endochondral bone growth that approach and overlap those of thanatophoric dysplasia type I. Some patients have femoral bowing with reverse tibial bowing. Other features include developmental delay and acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood, and some affected individuals have survived past infancy (Tavormina et al., 1999).

checks.claim: SADDAN is a severe skeletal dysplasia that approaches the severity of thanatophoric dysplasia type I.
checks.evidence_quote: skeletal dysplasia that approaches the severity observed in thanatophoric dysplasia type I (TD1)
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

checks.claim: SADDAN is caused by an activating mutation in FGFR3.
checks.evidence_quote: the Lys650Met mutation causes a dramatic increase in constitutive receptor kinase activity
checks.explanation: A constitutive increase in kinase activity means the mutation is activating.

checks.claim: Bellus et al. (1999) described severe disturbances in endochondral bone growth in SADDAN that approach and overlap those of thanatophoric dysplasia type I.
checks.evidence_quote: The FGFR3 Lys650Met mutation results in severe disturbances in endochondral bone growth that approach and overlap those observed in thanatophoric dysplasia, type I.
checks.explanation: The abstract says this almost word for word.

checks.claim: Some patients with SADDAN have femoral bowing with reverse tibial bowing.
checks.evidence_quote: Other unusual bone deformities, such as femoral bowing with reverse (i.e., posterior apex) tibial and fibular bowing and "ram's horn" bowing of the clavicle, are also seen in some patients.
checks.explanation: The abstract says some patients have femoral bowing with reverse tibial bowing. The claim leaves out the fibular bowing, but that does not make it wrong.

checks.claim: Features of SADDAN include developmental delay.
checks.evidence_quote: "severe achondroplasia with developmental delay and acanthosis nigricans" (SADDAN)
checks.explanation: Developmental delay is part of the phenotype's name, and the abstract also mentions severe neurological impairments.

checks.claim: Features of SADDAN include acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood.
checks.evidence_quote: three of the four individuals developed extensive areas of acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

checks.claim: Some individuals with SADDAN have survived past infancy.
checks.evidence_quote: have survived past infancy without prolonged life-support measures
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

paragraphs.text: Tavormina et al. (1999) reported 4 unrelated individuals with a skeletal dysplasia that they named SADDAN. The skeletal dysplasia approached the severity of thanatophoric dysplasia type I. However, some patients survived past infancy without prolonged life-support measures. Three of the 4 individuals had severe neurological impairment and developmental delay. Three of the 4 developed extensive areas of acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood.

checks.claim: Tavormina et al. (1999) reported 4 unrelated individuals with a skeletal dysplasia that they named SADDAN.
checks.evidence_quote: We have identified a novel fibroblast growth factor receptor 3 (FGFR3) missense mutation in four unrelated individuals with skeletal dysplasia
checks.explanation: The abstract reports four unrelated individuals and gives the phenotype the name SADDAN.

checks.claim: The skeletal dysplasia in the 4 individuals reported by Tavormina et al. (1999) approached the severity of thanatophoric dysplasia type I.
checks.evidence_quote: skeletal dysplasia that approaches the severity observed in thanatophoric dysplasia type I (TD1)
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

checks.claim: Some of the SADDAN patients reported by Tavormina et al. (1999) survived past infancy without prolonged life-support measures.
checks.evidence_quote: three of the four individuals developed extensive areas of acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood, suffer from severe neurological impairments, and have survived past infancy without prolonged life-support measures
checks.explanation: Three of the four survived past infancy, which fits 'some patients'.

checks.claim: Three of the 4 SADDAN individuals reported by Tavormina et al. (1999) had severe neurological impairment and developmental delay.
checks.evidence_quote: three of the four individuals developed extensive areas of acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood, suffer from severe neurological impairments
checks.explanation: The abstract says three of four had severe neurological impairments. Developmental delay appears only in the phenotype's name and is not tied to a count of three of four.

checks.claim: Three of the 4 SADDAN individuals reported by Tavormina et al. (1999) developed extensive areas of acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood.
checks.evidence_quote: three of the four individuals developed extensive areas of acanthosis nigricans beginning in early childhood
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

paragraphs.text: Bellus et al. (1999) noted that SADDAN involves severe disturbances in endochondral bone growth that approach and overlap those of thanatophoric dysplasia type I. Some patients have femoral bowing with reverse (posterior apex) tibial and fibular bowing.

checks.claim: Bellus et al. (1999) noted that SADDAN involves severe disturbances in endochondral bone growth that approach and overlap those of thanatophoric dysplasia type I.
checks.evidence_quote: The FGFR3 Lys650Met mutation results in severe disturbances in endochondral bone growth that approach and overlap those observed in thanatophoric dysplasia, type I.
checks.explanation: The abstract says this almost word for word.

checks.claim: Some patients with SADDAN have femoral bowing with reverse (posterior apex) tibial and fibular bowing.
checks.evidence_quote: Other unusual bone deformities, such as femoral bowing with reverse (i.e., posterior apex) tibial and fibular bowing and "ram's horn" bowing of the clavicle, are also seen in some patients.
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly, including that the reverse bowing has a posterior apex and involves the tibia and fibula.

paragraphs.text: In 4 unrelated individuals with SADDAN, Tavormina et al. (1999) identified an A1949T mutation in the FGFR3 gene. The mutation results in a lys650-to-met (K650M) substitution at a highly conserved codon in the activation loop of the kinase domain. In transient transfection studies, the K650M mutation caused a dramatic increase in constitutive receptor kinase activity.

checks.claim: Tavormina et al. (1999) identified an A1949T mutation in the FGFR3 gene in 4 unrelated individuals with SADDAN.
checks.evidence_quote: The FGFR3 mutation (A1949T: Lys650Met)
checks.explanation: The abstract reports this mutation in four unrelated individuals.

checks.claim: The FGFR3 A1949T mutation results in a lys650-to-met (K650M) substitution.
checks.evidence_quote: The FGFR3 mutation (A1949T: Lys650Met)
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

checks.claim: FGFR3 codon 650, affected by the K650M substitution, is highly conserved and lies in the activation loop of the kinase domain.
checks.evidence_quote: results in a different amino acid substitution at a highly conserved codon in the kinase domain activation loop
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

checks.claim: In transient transfection studies, the FGFR3 K650M mutation caused a dramatic increase in constitutive receptor kinase activity.
checks.evidence_quote: Transient transfection studies with FGFR3 mutant constructs show that the Lys650Met mutation causes a dramatic increase in constitutive receptor kinase activity
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

paragraphs.text: Iwata et al. (2001) stated that, in vitro, FGFR3 carrying the SADDAN mutation is more activated than FGFR3 carrying the thanatophoric dysplasia type II mutation.

checks.claim: Iwata et al. (2001) stated that, in vitro, FGFR3 carrying the SADDAN mutation is more activated than FGFR3 carrying the thanatophoric dysplasia type II mutation.
checks.evidence_quote: However, FGFR3 with the SADDAN mutation is more activated than FGFR3 with the TDII mutation in vitro.
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

paragraphs.text: In 4 unrelated individuals with SADDAN, Tavormina et al. (1999) identified a 1949A-T transversion in the FGFR3 gene. It results in a lys650-to-met (K650M) substitution in the activation loop of the kinase domain. The mutant receptor showed a dramatic increase in constitutive kinase activity.

checks.claim: Tavormina et al. (1999) identified a 1949A-T transversion in the FGFR3 gene in 4 unrelated individuals with SADDAN.
checks.evidence_quote: The FGFR3 mutation (A1949T: Lys650Met)
checks.explanation: A1949T is an A-to-T change, which is a transversion, and it was found in four unrelated individuals.

checks.claim: The FGFR3 1949A-T transversion results in a lys650-to-met (K650M) substitution in the activation loop of the kinase domain.
checks.evidence_quote: (A1949T: Lys650Met) occurs at the nucleotide adjacent to the TD type II (TD2) mutation (A1948G: Lys650Glu) and results in a different amino acid substitution at a highly conserved codon in the kinase domain activation loop
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.

checks.claim: The FGFR3 K650M mutant receptor showed a dramatic increase in constitutive kinase activity.
checks.evidence_quote: the Lys650Met mutation causes a dramatic increase in constitutive receptor kinase activity
checks.explanation: The abstract says this directly.
